assertions.name: geometric_li2q_towers_wrong_direction
assertions.source: Q_β needs a negative scaling correction (Q_codata/Q_A < 1) but both the geometric and Li_2^q E_0 towers give factors > 1 — refuted as the Q_β closure; only the cos eigenphase has the right direction.

description: Tests whether the Q_β c_k ladder is a 'wrong scaling' artifact: does a closed-form scaling (cos eigenphase, geometric E_0 tower, Li_2^q tower) close Q_β to compute precision at canonical q₀ with NO q₀-dependent c_k? Attributes the residual ladder and checks direction. Answers the user's 'all c_k wired / right scaling' question. Zero free parameters.

verdict.conclusion: Residual is in the scaling (eigenphase/E_0), per neutron-qvalue-symbolic.md. The cos eigenphase is the only closed-form scaling with the right direction; geometric/Li_2^q towers are refuted. Only c_2 wires (Taylor-exact); c_3+ are q₀-dependent and circular if extracted from Q_codata. All-c_k wiring needs the open Taylor-exact eigenphase refinement (the bridge). Production stays Q_N2.
